receiver_qualification.reference_payload_role: Strictly an optional post-recovery assertion comparator; does not participate in decryption, error correction, or deserialization.

reed_solomon_error_boundary.finding: In Phase 4C, Codeword 4 experienced exactly 16 symbol errors, reaching the maximum correction capability (t=16). Although fully recovered without data loss, it operated with zero safety margin on that block. Phase 5 adversarial or lossy channel deployment should incorporate bit-interleaving or higher ECC redundancy (e.g. 2t=48, t=24).

verdict_narrative: All 4 ONNX inference graphs exported at Opset 14, passed onnx.checker, and reopened in ONNX Runtime. Demodulated binary bits achieved 100% bit-exact identity (12/12 checks, 0.0 max absolute error). Adjusted tolerance (rtol=1e-4, atol=2e-5) passed 100.0% (66/66 checks). Strict tolerance (rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) achieved 58/66 passes (87.88%), with 8 context-dependent comparisons on val_image_1 (512x512) exhibiting minor 2-pixel discrepancies (max 1.37e-5 vs 1.19e-5 allowed) due to CPU SIMD FMA accumulation differences in ContextPredictorCNN. In accordance with Phase 5A verdict policy, the adopted verdict is PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS under adjusted tolerance.
